fields.name: Offer Letter
fields.content:
Date: {{ date }}

To,
{{ employee_name }}
{{ address }}

Subject: Offer of Employment

Dear {{ employee_name }},

We are delighted to extend an offer of employment to you for the position of {{ designation }} at Ardur Technology Private Limited. We were impressed with your skills and experience and believe you will be a valuable asset to our team.

Key Terms of Employment:

  • Start Date: {{ joining_date }}
  • Reporting Time: {{ reporting_time }}
  • Annual CTC: {{ ctc }}
  • Location: {{ location }}
  • Probation Period: {{ probation_period }} months
  • Notice Period: {{ notice_period }} days

Documents Required:
Please bring the following documents on your first day: {{ documents_to_bring }}.

This offer is valid until {{ offer_validity }}. Please sign and return the duplicate copy of this letter as a token of your acceptance.

We look forward to welcoming you aboard.

Sincerely,
For Ardur Technology Private Limited

Authorized Signatory

Date: {{ date }}

To,
{{ employee_name }}
Employee ID: {{ employee_id }}

Subject: Appointment Letter

Dear {{ employee_name }},

Subsequent to your acceptance of our offer, we are pleased to formally appoint you as {{ designation }} in the {{ department }} department, effective from {{ joining_date }}.

Terms and Conditions:

  • Work Location: You will be posted at {{ work_location }}. However, your services are transferable to any of our offices or client locations as per business requirements.
  • Reporting To: You will report to {{ reporting_manager }}.
  • Probation: You will be on probation for a period of {{ probation_period }} months.
  • Notice Period: During probation, the notice period is {{ notice_period_probation }} days. After confirmation, it is {{ notice_period_confirmed }} days.
  • Compensation: Your remuneration will be as per the agreed terms attached in Annexure A.

We wish you a long and fruitful career with us.

Sincerely,
For Ardur Technology Private Limited

Authorized Signatory
